title: Annual VIS output ranges from 53 to 174 papers
caption: The generated panel includes its question, chart specification, answer, and interaction instructions.
question: How many papers were published each year?
answer: From 1990 through 2024, IEEE VIS yearly output ranges from 53 papers in 1990 to 174 papers in 2004, within a 3,877-paper record. Treat the peak as an annual-volume high, not as evidence of paper type or venue mix by itself.
how_to_read: Read left to right: each point is one publication year, and higher points mean more papers that year.

interaction.instruction: Move the Start year slider to focus the line on later parts of the 1990–2024 record.
